description: Set a password, and optionally forbid printing or copying. Reads the local file, uploads it to the conv2pdf API, writes the protected PDF to output_path (or next to the input) and deletes the conversion job afterwards.

output_path.description: Local path the converted result is written to. When omitted, the output is written next to the input file. An existing file at this path is refused, never overwritten.

password.description: The new password to set on the output PDF (6 to 64 characters).

path.description: Local path of the input file. The file is read locally and uploaded to the conv2pdf API.

prevent_copy.description: When true, copying content from the protected PDF is forbidden.

prevent_print.description: When true, printing the protected PDF is forbidden.

name: protect_pdf
